params.val: target is an ally, using the same 'opponent = not self' convention as Dragon Cheer/Helping Hand

verified against Showdown data/abilities.ts (hospitality): heals ally.baseMaxhp / 4, i.e. the ally's un-Dynamaxed max HP -- so if the ally is Dynamaxed (doubled current max HP), the heal is still 25% of its normal (non-doubled) max HP, not 25% of the doubled value. Only adjacent allies (relevant in larger-than-singles formats).
